result:
Done.

**Root cause:** `clrCastleSq` in `variants/bug05/movegen.inc` masked the a1 corner with `and 0xFE` (clearing bit0 = white *kingside*) instead of `and 0xFD` (bit1 = white queenside, per the layout documented at `chess.asm:39`), so moving the a1 rook revoked the wrong right and the surviving queenside right let `genCastling` emit an O-O-O whose make/unmake round-trip in the post-move legal-move filter wrote a rook back onto a1 (`umOOO` restores it unconditionally) — hence a piece appearing during the opponent's move.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug05/movegen.inc` — a1 mask `0xFE` → `0xFD`, plus a header comment and one inline comment per corner. Exactly one byte of machine code changes (0x9149), verified by rebuilding with the mask reverted and byte-comparing.
- `variants/bug05/test_castling_rights.py` — new, 9-case regression test.
- `variants/bug05/Makefile` — `test:` runs it last.
- `variants/bug05/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — new, at the workspace root.

**Gate status**
- Repro 1 (phantom rook): PASS — `8/4k3/8/8/8/8/R7/4K3 w - - 2 2`, Matl 500.
- Repro 2 (O-O-O after Ra1 left): PASS — refused, log stops at `a1a2 e8e7`.
- Repro 3 (O-O after Ra1 left): PASS — accepted, `5RK1`.
- Report's two controls: PASS, unchanged.
- Built-in `T` self-test: PASS — `kiwipete d3 97862 OK`, `PERFT OK - movegen verified`.
- `make test` (6 checks): PASS, 26 s.
- New test: PASS 9/9; verified discriminating — 4/9 fail on a reverted-mask build with exactly the reported symptoms, while the mirror/control cases stay green.
- Review: one synchronous round, **no defect found in the fix** → gate closed. The reviewer reproduced every claim independently, confirmed the bit mapping against all consumers, found no second instance of the bug class, and hand-checked all 9 test expectations.

**Knowingly left open** (all pre-existing and out of scope, recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md`): the take-back stack silently stops recording past 48 plies (`pushGameUndo`), which is the one route by which the symptom is still reachable; the tape/FEN loader accepts a castling field inconsistent with the board; the test covers the capture path only on a1; `takeBack` doesn't rewind `moveLogN`; the null-move search doesn't update `hashKey`. One reviewer finding was a false invariant I had written into `FIX_NOTES.md` — I verified it against `movegen.inc:1311` and rewrote that paragraph.
